result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Neither answer sticks fully to the fact sheet. A adds 'Alle Features des Creator-Plans' to Studio, which the sheet never says, and 'ohne versteckte Kosten'. Its line 'jederzeit Inhalte hinzufügen' also blurs Starter's limit of 3 new episodes a month, and it has typos. B invents 'ohne Kreditkarte' and the option to delete a show, and changes 'jederzeit kündbar' to 'monatlich kündbar'. Even so, B states every plan's limits plainly and frames each plan more cleanly, so it comes out slightly ahead. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers add things that aren't on the fact sheet. A adds 'ohne Kreditkarte', turns 'jederzeit kündbar' into 'monatlich kündbar', and frames Starter as a way to test, which comes close to trial language. Its closing note brings up the trial and guarantee, but only as a note to the requester, not in the plan copy. B states cancellation exactly as the sheet does, but it adds 'Alle Features des Creator-Plans' to Studio and 'ohne versteckte Kosten', and its 'jederzeit Inhalte hinzufügen' slightly blurs the Starter limit. Even so, B is a little more faithful overall and does a better job of showing what each plan changes for the podcaster.
